title: 第19章 太漂亮的女生都有点病第20章 很贵吗
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：财富自由从毕业开始第19章太漂亮的女生都有点病（..）周望不仅看到了“彩云大学”
，他还同时看到了“专业学位研究生论文”
几个大字。
这位清冷的漂亮姐姐居然是一个研究生？
不过这样也才对，姜沫明显要大他好几岁，如果还是学生的话，也只能是研究生了。
“嗯……你也是么？”
姜沫挪动了一下手中的书本将论文遮住，低头问道。
“对啊，不过我已经毕业了，当初辅导员倒是劝我考研，可惜……”
“可惜什么？”
姜沫本来不是好奇心重的人，但还是忍不住问了一句。
“可是我学艺不精，知道自己考不上，当然不会白费功夫。”
周望耸了耸肩坐了下来。
嗯？
姜沫有些迷惑，以周望看书的那个架势，怎么看都不像個学渣啊！
“那你来图书馆是为了……”
周望本来以为两人的聊天已经结束了，没想到过了一会儿姜沫又开口问道。
“为了房子。”
“啊？”
姜沫小小的呆滞了一下，又变得有些萌萌的，让周望很有掐一下她脸蛋的冲动。
“书中自有黄金屋嘛。”

说实话的周望直接用出了系统的解读。
“噢。”
姜沫没有再说话，但周望却捕捉到了她嘴角似乎勾动了一下，那个笑容很浅，而且是一闪而逝，可竟是莫名的惊艳。
这大抵就是传说中的反差美？
把咖啡放好以后，周望重新去了图书借阅区，找了余华的《活着》拿回来看。
吃饭时间简短的休息，也只是让他的精神稍微好了一点，不宜挑战太高难度的著作，这种现实主义题材的小说刚刚合适。
而且这本书的积分可不低，足足60点，比《国富论》这种学术著作还要高，周望估摸着，也许是因为它传递的是另一种更难懂的学问吧？
经过刚才那番简短的对话后，周望本来以为他和姜沫的距离应该更拉近了一点，但等重新坐下来之后周望才发现自己想多了。
姜沫不仅没有再开口说过一句话，也没有看他一眼，甚至于，周望为了感谢她帮忙占座带的那杯咖啡，也不知何时被她轻轻推了过来，拒绝的意思很明显。
周望倒也无所谓，他又不是天狗座，不会在别人明显表达疏远的时候，还硬要死皮赖脸的贴上去。
偶尔休息的间隙，能有这么个大美女坐在对面赏心悦目，本身就已经足够了。
时间流逝，从下午到天色完全漆黑，等周望听到闭馆的提示声响起，头大如斗的从《金瓶梅》馆藏崇祯本里脱离出来的时候，才发现时针已经指向了八点半。
手中的《金瓶梅》终究还是没有看完，进度只到达了三分之一的样子。
主要是越到后面他的状态越差，等看完《活着》的时候，周望已经很难再进入那种专注的姿态了。
接着看《金瓶梅》，只是为了试验一下自身的极限，目前看来，只能说强撸灰飞烟灭。
虽然没有能够如同预想那般看完四本书，但其实今天的收获已经足够。
三本书总计为周望贡献了130点的积分，等于一套三居室已经到手。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book lovers: Wealth and Freedom Begins from Graduation Chapter 19 Girls who are too beautiful are sick (..) Zhou Wang not only saw "Caiyun University"
, he also saw the "Professional Degree Graduate Thesis"
A few big words.
This cold and beautiful sister is actually a graduate student?
But this is only right. Jiang Mo is obviously several years older than him. If he is still a student, he can only be a graduate student.
"Um...you too?"
Jiang Mo moved the book in his hand to cover the paper, lowered his head and asked.
"Yes, but I have already graduated. At the beginning, the counselor persuaded me to take the postgraduate entrance examination, but it's a pity..."
"What's a pity?"
Jiang Mo was not a very curious person, but he couldn't help but ask.
"But I'm not good at studying. I know I won't pass the exam, so of course I won't waste my efforts."
Zhou Wang shrugged and sat down.
Um?
Jiang Mo was a little confused. With the way Zhou Wang was reading, he didn't look like a scumbag at all!
"Then why did you come to the library..."
Zhou Wang originally thought the chat between the two was over, but he didn't expect Jiang Mo to ask again after a while.
"For the house."
"Huh?"
Jiang Mo was stunned for a moment, then became a little cute again, which made Zhou Wang have the urge to pinch her cheek.
"There is a golden house in the book."
Zhou Wang, who was telling the truth, directly used systematic interpretation.
"Oh."
Jiang Mo didn't speak anymore, but Zhou Wang caught the corners of her mouth seeming to twitch. The smile was very shallow and fleeting, but it was inexplicably stunning.
Is this probably the legendary beauty of contrast?
After putting away the coffee, Zhou Wang went to the book lending area again, found Yu Hua's "Alive" and took it back to read.
The brief rest during meal time only made him feel a little better. It was not appropriate to challenge a work that was too difficult. This kind of realistic novel was just right.
And the points of this book are not low, a full 60 points, which is higher than academic works such as "The Wealth of Nations". Zhou Wang guessed, maybe because it conveys another kind of knowledge that is more difficult to understand?
After the brief conversation just now, Zhou Wang originally thought that the distance between him and Jiang Mo should be closer, but after sitting down again, Zhou Wang realized that he had been thinking too much.
Not only did Jiang Mo not say another word, but she also didn't look at him. In fact, Zhou Wang was gently pushed over by her at some point in order to thank her for the cup of coffee she had brought with her. Her refusal was obvious.
It doesn't matter to Zhou Wang, he is not a Tengu, and he will not insist on sticking up to others when they clearly express their alienation.
During the occasional breaks, it is enough in itself to have such a beautiful woman sitting across from her and enjoying her eyes.
Time passed, and the sky became completely dark from afternoon. When Zhou Wang heard the closing reminder and got out of the Chongzhen edition of the "Jin Ping Mei" collection with his head as big as a bucket, he realized that the hour hand had pointed to half past eight.
After all, I haven't finished reading "The Golden Ping Mei" in my hand, and the progress is only one-third of the way.
The main reason was that his condition got worse towards the end. By the time he finished watching "Alive", it was difficult for Zhou Wang to get into that focused posture again.
Then I watched "Jin Ping Mei", just to test my own limits. At present, I can only say that I will be wiped out by force.
Although I was not able to finish reading four books as expected, I actually gained enough today.
The three books contributed a total of 130 points to Zhou Wang, which is equivalent to getting a three-bedroom apartment.
